more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Sucralose is used as a sweetener in food. Its technological role is to provide sweetness.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include meal replacement for weight control as referred to in Commission Regulation (EU) no 432/2012, flavoured drinks, flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, edible ices. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 15 mg/kg body weight/day (EFSA, 2026; previous limit retained).
more_info.side_effects:
Currently authorised food uses raised no concern in the 2026 EFSA assessment.
Prolonged high-temperature use had unresolved breakdown-product uncertainties, preventing confirmation of the proposed bakery-use extension.
more_info.precautions: EFSA identified uncertainty about breakdown products during prolonged high-temperature baking or frying in its 2026 assessment.
